testcase.name: adding a server keeps the existing ones
an empty address is refused instead of writing a dead row
address splitting handles ports and IPv6 literals
a truncated status answer surfaces as an error not as zeros
a corrupt servers dat does not stop the player from adding a server
a plain string motd and a missing favicon still parse
a gzipped file written by another tool still reads
bedrock port is reported as unknown without touching the network
broken files read as an empty list instead of throwing
write then read gives the same list back
moving renaming and removing touch only the target row
pinning moves the server to the top and keeps the rest in order
ping parses the status answer of a real socket
